## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one focused purpose.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or their absence is explained.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples match the behavior.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated, or no user-visible entry is required.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are explicit.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets or local-machine data.
